news.title: Atirador mata pelo menos 4 pessoas em escola dos Estados Unidos
news.summary: Um atirador de 16 anos abriu fogo nessa quinta-feira (15) em uma escola em Bend, no estado norte-americano do Oregon, matando quatro pessoas, incluindo três crianças. Ele foi morto por um morador da comunidade que o havia perseguido até dentro da escola, informou a polícia. O atirador entrou na Escola Primária Silver Rail atirando nas portas trancadas, disse a polícia, sem fornecer mais detalhes além da idade do suspeito. Notícias relacionadas: Atiradora em escola canadense tem 18 anos e problemas de saúde mental. Tiroteio em Minneapolis deixa três mortos, incluindo suposto atirador. As vítimas são crianças de 5, 8 e 11 anos e um professor. Além disso, um aluno de 7 anos e um professor de 54 foram levados ao hospital com ferimentos graves, informou o chefe de polícia de Bend, Mike Krantz, em entrevista.coletiva A governadora do Oregon, Tina Kotek, que participou da coletiva, agradeceu ao integrante da comunidade que “interveio heroicamente para impedir mais perdas de vidas”. “Nenhum pai ou mãe deveria passar por um dia assim, e nenhuma comunidade deveria ter que viver isso. E à medida que soubermos mais sobre as crianças e os adultos que foram mortos ou feridos, e sobre suas famílias e entes queridos, vamos chorar muito, vamos chorar juntos e, provavelmente, vamos chorar em particular”, disse Kotek. Krantz afirmou que o membro da comunidade, cuja identidade ele não revelou, viu o suspeito entrar na escola e o perseguiu. Tiroteios em escolas se tornaram um fenômeno recorrente na vida norte-americana, incluindo ataques de grande repercussão , como os ocorridos na Columbine High School em 1999, na Sandy Hook Elementary School em 2012, na Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School em 2018 e na Robb Elementary School em Uvalde, Texas, em 2022. Cada tiroteio reacende os debates sobre as leis de porte de armas em um país onde o direito ao porte é protegido pela Segunda Emenda da Constituição . Defensores do direito ao porte de armas têm sugerido o armamento de professores como forma de defesa. Krantz disse que todos os policiais de Bend passaram por um dia inteiro de treinamento para lidar com atiradores ativos em agosto. “Infelizmente, isso é algo para o qual treinamos regularmente, e precisamos fazer isso”, declarou Krantz. “Essa será uma investigação longa.” * ( Reportagem adicional de Kanishka Singh e Jasper Ward ) * É proibida a reprodução deste conteúdo.

news.summary: It is the first time the president has addressed nuclear weapons, but he didn't deny US could use 'mother of all bombs'.

news.title: Kallas admite que Europa no puede sustituir a Starlink a corto plazo ante las restricciones de EEUU a Ucrania
news.summary: La Alta Representante de la Unión Europea para Política Exterior, Kaja Kallas, ha lamentado que "desafortunadamente" el bloque no puede reemplazar en un corto espacio de tiempo el sistema de Internet por satélite Starlink, propiedad del magnate Elon Musk, y ha dicho que la creación de una alternativa europea es una de las prioridades de la Agencia Europea de Defensa.

news.title: Amyr Klink ganha filme e explica por que não quis ajudar a filha Tamara a virar navegadora: 'História se constrói, não se herda'

news.title: How books are being scanned and destroyed to train artificial intelligence
news.summary: To train artificial intelligence models, millions of physical books are being digitised and destroyed. Our colleagues at France 2 investigate this controversial practice and the risk of seeing many rare second-hand books disappear forever.

news.title: Shooter kills teacher, three children at Oregon elementary school
news.summary: A teenager shot and killed three children and a teacher on Thursday at an elementary school in the US state of Oregon, police said, adding the assailant was later killed by an armed bystander who pursued him into the building. Officers rushed to Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, a city of about 100,000 in the nation's northwest, after reports of a shooter on campus on Thursday afternoon. The three children who died on the scene were aged five, eight and 11, said Bend police chief Mike Krantz.

news.title: US considers hitting Iran with 'Mother of All Bombs'
news.summary: The United States is considering using its biggest non-nuclear bomb against Iran if President Donald Trump should decide to renew combat in the war that has hit a deadlock, CNN reported Thursday. Diplomatic efforts to end the conflict, which erupted with US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February, have been at an impasse since the summer. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Kethevane Gorjestani tells us more.

news.title: Francia vuelve a permitir el uso de granadas aturdidoras de cara a las protestas de este sábado
news.summary: El ministro del Interior de Francia, Laurent Nuñez, ha anunciado este viernes que las fuerzas de seguridad podrán recurrir al uso de granadas aturdidoras de cara a las protestas previstas para este sábado tras un breve periodo de suspensión ante las críticas recibidas por por el caso de un adolescente de 15 años que perdió una mano durante las manifestaciones estudiantiles.

news.title: China-North Korea border bridge may do little to spur trade, experts say
news.summary: Sanctions and a North Korean leadership that prioritises security dim prospects for trade, analysts say.

news.title: Zelensky rallies European allies as Trump ties slump
news.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky is seeking to rally European allies at a Brussels summit on Friday after saying Kyiv would no longer abide by US President Donald Trump's demands not to strike Russian oil refineries. Relations between Kyiv and Washington have soured since last week, when Trump eased sanctions on Russia in exchange for Moscow releasing large amounts of diesel onto global markets.

news.title: EU leaders face budget divisions, discuss Ukraine at Brussels summit
news.summary: European Union leaders gathered in Brussels on Thursday for a two-day summit to discuss the bloc’s next long-term budget, continued support for Ukraine and measures to strengthen Europe’s economic competitiveness amid rising energy prices and geopolitical uncertainty. They voiced strong opposition to a new proposal for the bloc’s long-term budget, raising serious doubt about whether the key spending package will be agreed by the end of year. FRANCE 24's Dave Keating reports from Brussels.

Finally, this year's animal of the year has been named.

news.title: No, this oil tanker didn’t carry Russian diesel to the United States
news.summary: Following US President Donald Trump's October 9 announcement of an agreement signed with Russian President Vladimir Putin to import Russian diesel into the United States, a number of pro-Russian social media accounts began claiming that a Russian oil tanker was already carrying thousands of barrels of diesel to the United States. The ship was actually carrying fertiliser.

news.title: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded
news.summary: Three children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher were killed after a 16-year-old suspect opened fire in the city of Bend, local police say.

news.title: Students join Yellow Vest protest: Greater collective strength versus risk of losing distinct voice
news.summary: As student protests converge with broader public discontent over the rising cost of living in France, Genie Godula is joined by Sébastien Vieille, national secretary of the SNALC teachers’ union. He offers an assessment of a movement confronting political uncertainty, deteriorating school infrastructure and mounting fiscal constraints. Speaking from Montbéliard in eastern France, Vieille questions whether alliances with larger protest movements, including the Yellow Vests, will strengthen students’ demands or ultimately make them "less visible".

news.title: Trump pone sobre la mesa el uso de 'la madre de todas las bombas' en caso de nuevo ataque contra Irán
news.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ha afirmado que Washington sopesa el uso de la bomba GBU-43/B --conocida coloquialmente como MOAB, 'la madre de todas las bombas'-- contra Irán y ha reiterado que la guerra con Irán "va a terminar muy pronto, de una forma u otra", en medio de la falta de avances durante los últimos meses en las conversaciones para poner fin al conflicto en Oriente Próximo.

news.title: El Supremo de Venezuela valida el proyecto de reforma de la Ley contra el Odio de cara a su debate en el Parlamento
news.summary: El Tribunal Supremo de Justicia (TSJ) de Venezuela ha validado el proyecto de reforma parcial de la Ley Constitucional contra el Odio, que la oposición denuncia que fue usada para reprimir y perseguir a disidentes, con lo que allana el camino para su debate en el Parlamento.

news.title: Indian authorities detain 'cockroach' movement founder Dipke ahead of new protest
news.summary: Indian authorities on Friday detained Abhijeet Dipke, the founder of the satirical youth movement "Cockroach Janta Party", ahead of a new protest in New Delhi, live images from the group showed. Police earlier closed a central New Delhi park in an attempt to stifle near-daily demonstrations calling for the election authority chief's resignation over the removal of more than 130 million people from voter lists.

news.title: Indian authorities heighten security, close park ahead of 'cockroach' movement rally
news.summary: Authorities have closed a central park in the Indian capital ahead of the latest protest by the youth-led "Cockroach Janta Party". The group has held near-daily demonstrations calling for the national election authority chief's resignation over the removal of more than 130 million people from voter lists.

news.title: Un terremoto de magnitud 6,9 sacude la península rusa de Kamchatka
news.summary: Un terremoto de magnitud 6,9 ha sacudido la península rusa de Kamchatka, situada en el extremo oriente del país, provocando que numerosos residentes evacuaran sus viviendas ante la intensidad de los temblores, según ha informado la filial regional del Servicio Geofísico de la Academia de Ciencias de Rusia.

news.title: Which countries waste the most food, and how to reduce waste at home
news.summary: This World Food Day, 645 million people are going hungry, yet more than a billion tonnes of food is wasted annually.

news.title: Midterms 2026: Can Democrats capitalise on Latino voter regret?
news.summary: In 2024, a 46 percent share of the Latino vote helped propel Donald Trump to the White House. But two years on, polls show that support has plummeted in spectacular fashion. Amid an immigration crackdown, violent ICE raids and the spiraling cost of living, some Latino voters say they regret having backed Trump at the ballot box. Now, as the midterms approach, can the Democrats capitalise on this sense of regret to win back what was once an essential part of their base? France 24 reporters Sam Ball and Barbara Gabel met with Latino voters and local Democrats in Phoenix, Arizona, to find out.

news.title: UK bookstores scramble as Sally Rooney's novels pulled over Palestine Action support
news.summary: Critically acclaimed Irish novelist Sally Rooney's announcement that her books could no longer be sold in the UK due to her support for proscribed group Palestine Action has left British booksellers rushing to stock up on her works before distributors run out. The British government's ban on the group, which practiced non-violent direct action and sabotage against UK military assets believed to be working with the Israeli government, makes support for Palestine Action punishable by up to 14 years in prison.

news.summary: Designed to bring internet access to remote regions, Elon Musk's Starlink has become vital in crisis regions and war zones. But Ukraine also shows the risks of depending on the service.

news.title: Marseille's woes continue with second consecutive Europa League defeat
news.summary: Things are going from bad to worse for Marseille. The French side suffered their second defeat in as many Europa League matches, losing 1-0 to Olympiakos. Lyon, meanwhile, are heading in the opposite direction, having secured a win over Premier League side Crystal Palace. Rennes, for their part, claimed their first Europa League victory of the season with a narrow 2-1 win over OFI Crete.
